scope: Test-harness probe of precise Split worker output transport, not an application implementation or a browser measurement.
fixture: Original ply-3.ply (SHA-256 bf738cb1da7aa2e2d26bc143c33e04313ad5096069d91cc22338cd0b01e9dcc2), 3691133 input faces and the same midpoint finite planar cutter used in m2-shared-split-original-scans-20261028.json.
method: The actual processing-worker dispatcher runs with a persistent geometry key. Its test scope postMessage either uses its ordinary structuredClone transfer list or, in the probe only, converts the two number-array coordinate carriers to Float64Array, transfers those buffers, and converts them back to number arrays on receipt. The probe checks SHA-256 of canonical little-endian binary64 coordinates before packing and after unpacking, indexed/expanded equality, source-buffer hashes, surface area and nonempty cut diagnostics. Neither probe mutates production transport code.
limitations: The probe packs inside a mocked postMessage and unpacks in the same process; browser workers and main-thread scheduling or independent process memory have not been measured.

This does not validate persistent cache reuse, cancellation, error handling, all alias relationships, GUI/public-MCP behavior, project persistence or native equivalence after an application transport change.
The normal path reported a peak slightly above the configured job limit. The guarded test passed and cleaned up, but the measurement does not demonstrate usable headroom.
